defects: Mohammed is in a deformed, foreshortened semi-sitting squat on top of the right mattress instead of lying down along the bed, making his torso look like a round sack with stubby legs sticking straight toward camera.
Mohammed's hands are down by his hips/sides instead of resting on his chest as the brief requires.
Mohammed's head is tipped sharply backward with wide-open eyes staring at the ceiling instead of having heavy, half-closed feverish eyes.
Camera framing is a wide shot rather than starting on a medium shot (M) for the M-to-CU push.
tiles.fix: Lay Mohammed flat along the right mattress with his head on the pillow, level his chin with heavy half-closed eyelids, place both hands resting on his chest, and frame the start of the push as a true medium shot (M).

defects: Mohammed remains in the same foreshortened potato-like semi-sitting pose with stubby legs pointing at camera instead of lying naturally on the mattress.
His hands are at his sides/hips rather than resting on his chest.
His head is tilted back with wide-open eyes staring at the ceiling instead of heavy eyelids.
tiles.fix: Use the corrected lying-down pose with hands resting on his chest, head properly supported on the pillow, and heavy half-shut eyes.

defects: The push ends in a loose medium shot rather than the required close-up (CU) on Mohammed.

In this closer crop, Mohammed's broken pose is even more obvious: his bare feet float above the mattress, his hands sit down by his hips instead of on his chest, his neck sinks into his torso, and his eyes are wide open staring upward.
tiles.fix: Push the camera into a true close-up (CU) of Mohammed's head and upper chest, with his hands resting on his chest and his eyes heavy and half-closed.

defects: Zoubida is posed upright facing straight toward the camera in front of the bed with her lower skirt sinking into the floor, reading as a dwarfed standing figure rather than kneeling beside the bed toward her sick son.
Zoubida's hands are held against her lower cheeks/jaw instead of pressing both palms to her temples as directed.
A harsh, elongated black shadow stretches across the floor from Zoubida toward the left table.
On the mattress behind Zoubida's left arm, Mohammed is still in the deformed semi-sitting pose with his head tipped back and hands at his sides.
tiles.fix: Kneel Zoubida on the floor directly beside the right mattress angled toward Mohammed with clear knee/skirt contact on the floor, raise both of her palms to her temples, soften the floor shadow, and place Mohammed in the corrected lying-down pose with hands on his chest.

defects: Zoubida is still upright facing the camera with her lower skirt sunken into the floor instead of clearly kneeling beside the bed.
Her right hand has dropped to her chest/collarbone and her left hand is at her cheek, failing the brief's 'both palms to her temples, rocking' gesture.
Mohammed in the background remains in the broken foreshortened pose with wide eyes and hands at his sides.
tiles.fix: Keep Zoubida kneeling beside the mattress with both palms pressed to her temples while rocking her upper torso, and keep Mohammed lying flat with hands on his chest.

worst_problem: In the 3D shots (b152 and b154), Mohammed is squashed into a grotesque foreshortened semi-sitting pose with wide-open eyes and hands at his hips instead of lying flat with heavy eyes and hands on his chest, while Zoubida stands/sinks into the floor facing camera with hands at her cheeks/chest instead of kneeling by the bed with both palms to her temples.
